Made by **[notrandom.fun](https://notrandom.fun)**.

**Chrome Web Store review is pending.** This download is for installation with Chrome's Developer mode while we wait for Google's review.

1. Download **callout-stats.zip** below and unzip it.
2. Open `chrome://extensions` in desktop Chrome and enable **Developer mode**.
3. Click **Load unpacked**, then choose the extracted folder containing `manifest.json`.
4. Open or refresh [pump.fun](https://pump.fun/).

No terminal, build tools, wallet connection or API key needed. See the [README](https://github.com/MarkUnthank/pump-fun-callout-stats#install) for usage and updating instructions.

`SHA256SUMS.txt` contains the package checksum. Source code, bundled icons and Chrome Web Store screenshots are available in the repository. This release contains only the extension frontend; it uses notrandom.fun's hosted stats service.
